title: Temperature Fluctuations and quantum corrections near Black Hole Horizon
summary: Spatially varying near-horizon fluctuations of temperature of a Schwarzschild Black Hole is considered within the Euclidean Gravity approach. We present evidence that suggests that such fluctuations in temperature are closely related with the near-horizon supertranslations of a Black Hole. This allows one to express the temperature-dependent corrections to the near-horizon part of the Euclidean gravity action or Free energy in terms of polynomial functionals of a near-horizon supertranslation for all orders.
